title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I do know him but I don’t have his number
Another one you told PR to announce so I couldn’t break it
Another trade is coming out Sunday

Hey, taking a step back. Been a long week for me personally and professionally. I understand our relationship has changed and I am not going to go scorched earth on you every time you don’t help me out anymore like you have in the past. Thank you for getting back to me earlier, have a good day.
